reason: Review of photoreceptor sensory cilia and inherited retinal degeneration; RPGR is a connecting-cilium protein and a core IRD gene, and BBS12 fits the ciliopathy theme. Abstract empty, so judged from title.
Multifocal ERG study in X-linked retinoschisis patients; XLRS is the RS1 disease, so this is directly on topic.
Hedgehog signaling in adult lung quiescence and repair; general Hh pathway biology with no SMO-specific or ocular/SMO-disease link in title or abstract.
Review of spliceosome mutations in cancer and immunity; general spliceosome biology, not RNU4ATAC (U4atac minor spliceosome snRNA) or its disease.
Congenital aniridia review centred on PAX6; TRIM44 is not an aniridia gene and is not discussed in the abstract.
Ophthalmic features of basal cell nevus syndrome (Gorlin). BCNS is mainly PTCH1-driven and SMO is only a minor contributor, so the SMO link is weak; it is a Hh-pathway disease but not SMO-specific.
Tests Hedgehog pathway as a cell-autonomous modifier of Pkd1-driven polycystic kidney disease. Hh pathway, not SMO gene biology per se; no ocular link and SMO is not the focus.

Xenopus Xhip (Hedgehog-interacting protein) in olfactory and lens placode formation. Hh-pathway developmental eye-adjacent work; SMO not named in title, RAX is an eye-field homeobox but not clearly discussed. Abstract empty.

Mechanistic study of CcHL/HCCS (System III holocytochrome c synthase) substrate recognition. HCCS is the gene itself; HCCS loss-of-function causes MLS (microphthalmia with linear skin defects). The SMO tag is spurious but HCCS is on topic.
Shh and Ihh ligand requirements in gut development; ligand-level GI biology with no SMO focus and no ocular link in the abstract.
